negative_mutations.target: one slow, failed, filled or timed-out real attempt
negative_mutations.description: Every real attempt must remain in the sealed population and reliability denominator.

surfaces.description: Exact 100-of-120 sample gate, window balance, terminal reliability, fill-race and unresolved-exposure formulas.

decision_time.observed_at_rule: Compute after L0 sealing from all target attempts; no row can be removed or added after the 120-attempt cap.

exact_contract.value_contract: At least 100 eligible target rows from at most 120 total attempts, three preselected windows with at least 20 rows each, largest share at most 0.50, terminal fraction at least 0.99 and zero unresolved exposure.
exact_contract.row_identity: SHA256 of the canonical reliability summary and attempt-population identity.

negative_mutations.target: attempt 121 or a result-dependent top-up campaign
negative_mutations.description: The same task revision must stop at 120 attempts and become inconclusive when the eligible floor is not met.

surfaces.description: Exact nearest-rank p95, upward 50ms bucket and single controller recommendation.

exact_contract.value_contract: Recommendation is exactly retain_100ms_as_preregistered_scenario, revise_primary_tuple_before_outcomes, latency_measurement_inconclusive_h0b_locked or execution_path_reliability_not_established_h0b_locked.
exact_contract.row_identity: SHA256 of the canonical recommendation inputs and output enum.

negative_mutations.target: p95 method, percentile or upward bucket rule
negative_mutations.description: Interpolation, another percentile or downward rounding must fail.

Every emitted JSON/CSV/report field is source-derived or uses the frozen explicit null representation; zero never represents missing.
Every artifact has an exact key, type, ordered-field and value universe with unknown keys and fields rejected.
L0, sealed L1, staging, formal and archive trees reject unknown paths, symlinks and special entries.
Unchanged Trust Kernel, H0-A and current GLFT production-dry claims bind the accepted QA/closure/contract evidence.
All fifteen declared negative mutations execute on current and frozen implementations with exact stable codes and fail-open count zero.
Gate 0, fake-clock/client safety tests and current/frozen hostile preflight pass before credentials or private endpoints are accessed.
